card.name: Start of instruction sentences
card.fires_on: The first word or sentence-ending mark right before an instruction or directive, such as 'should read', 'Refer to', 'You can check', or a period before the next step. It appears in manuals, course guides and preparation steps.

modes.label: Directive opener
modes.description: A verb or pronoun that begins an instruction telling the reader what to do or consult.

modes.description: A full stop ending a procedural sentence just before the next step or table.
